image_description: A close-up, slightly low-resolution image of a black ring binder lying open or partially collapsed. The spine is visible on the left with a pink/magenta label insert in a clear pocket. The right side shows the internal ring mechanism holding a stack of papers with colored edges (red, yellow). The binder appears to be made of vinyl or plastic.

artifact_observations.location: entire image, especially paper edges and ring mechanism
artifact_observations.reasoning: Significant lack of sharpness and detail resolution. Edges of the paper stack and metal rings are soft and indistinct, suggesting either low-quality generation or heavy compression artifacts typical of AI images struggling with fine mechanical details.
The connection between the rings and the paper holes is vague. The rings do not clearly pierce or hold the paper in a physically precise manner; they seem to merge slightly with the paper edges.
The colored edges of the paper (red/yellow) bleed into each other and lack the distinct striations of individual sheets, appearing as a solid block of color rather than stacked paper.
